title: Sensory-context modulation of optogenetic calcium response investigation

titles: Visual cortical sequence filtering with holographic perturbation and matched sensory context

scientific_question: What measured incremental optogenetic response contrasts differ across visual contexts within each original source block, and does the evidence support an interaction beyond additive visual/opto responses?
primary_outputs: Prespecified within-block differences of matched visual-plus-opto, visual-only and opto-only response summaries, plus available-context support and original-versus-revision-pool discrepancies, independently recomputed from measured traces.

data_manifest.file_count_scope: Top-level published assets, including code/docs where packaged together; not a participant count.

recording_contract.neural: figure2_data.npz includes panelBC_F_abc and F_cba documented as 257 cells × 50 trials × 200 frames, plus six-experiment traces for other panels. Figure3 includes full traces and also cell × time condition summaries; those summaries are not independent trials.
recording_contract.labels: Stimulated/nonstimulated indices, spatial patterns, trial-order keys and ABC/CBA order. Figure3 sources distinguish visual-only, opto-only and matched/unmatched visual-plus-opto conditions.
recording_contract.time_alignment: Known frame indices and analysis windows in source; exact per-experiment frame-time/stimulation-onset contract has not been verified. Do not convert arbitrary frame indices into milliseconds or infer cross-experiment synchronization.
recording_contract.biological_ids: Archive keys expose experiment IDs, including expt1–6, but inspected manifest/README/source did not establish a complete experiment→mouse→session map or whether panel examples repeat an acquisition. Neuron/cell and panel counts are not animal counts.
recording_contract.evidence: 7.37 GB archive central directory (14 entries), full README, Figure2/3 notebook source and helper inspected by small ranges. Input arrays were not downloaded.

primary.name: within_block_interaction_report_numerical_error
primary.aggregation: Compare every prespecified native-unit incremental-opto and interaction contrast, support count and undefined disposition with independent recomputation; retain separate source blocks and frozen tolerances.
primary.rationale: Scores correct numerical extraction from measured observations rather than agreement with a narrative or report shape. The delivered evaluator checks every available declared operand with abs(error)/(1e-8 + 1e-6*abs(reference)); correct arithmetic does not establish a causal or biological interpretation.

secondary: Report additive-model residual contrasts with visual-only/opto-only controls wherever the required conditions exist.
Original-block versus revision-pool support and sensitivity; missing conditions remain unavailable.
Explicit source membership duplication, frame-window definitions and optical-artifact sensitivity.

comparators.name: Additive visual plus opto response
comparators.inputs: Matched visual-only, opto-only and baseline conditions within each block.
comparators.procedure: Compute additive expected response using fixed native-frame summaries; if a required condition is absent, mark interaction unavailable.

comparators.name: Context-dependent incremental opto response
comparators.inputs: Matched visual-plus-opto and visual-only observations within source block.
comparators.procedure: Estimate within-block difference and its contrast across contexts; do not pool revision/original arrays to inflate precision.

comparators.name: Artifact/window sensitivity
comparators.inputs: Equivalent unstimulated/baseline windows and power/timing metadata where measured.
comparators.procedure: Prespecify diagnostics in native frames until physical clocks are verified; do not invent120ms equivalence.

Structural admission must be followed by independent numerical grading; a scientifically wrong but well-shaped report cannot earn correctness.
